procedure: Walk the booking workflow with scheduling and clinic representatives
expected_result: Normal, urgent, cancellation and downtime paths each have an owner

procedure: Attempt unavailable provider and room combinations
expected_result: Invalid combinations are rejected and no partial booking is retained

procedure: Submit two simultaneous requests for the same provider and room
expected_result: Exactly one booking succeeds; second request receives a controlled conflict

procedure: Attempt cross-department access using a restricted role
expected_result: Unauthorized records are not returned and the attempt is auditable

procedure: Reconcile the pilot appointment list after reschedules and cancellations
expected_result: No duplicate active allocations or orphan slots remain

procedure: Review downtime and support procedures with operations
expected_result: Operational owner accepts recovery, exception queue and support escalation
